title: Wolfe.Lab declaration
description: A service, a component or a node of the lab (ROADMAP.md #14). Name this schema in a file's first line to make it one of the lab's.

kind.description: What the document declares: a service, a node, or what a component is used for.
A service: the unit the catalog lists, declared in its own directory.

name.description: The service's name, which is its directory's.

displayName.description: The name people read, when the name is not it.

description.description: What the service is, in a sentence.

lifecycle.description: Where the service is in its life; production unless it says otherwise.

title.description: What the link is called on the page.

url.description: An absolute URL. A link has a url or a path.

path.description: A path relative to this file, for a file in the repository. A link has a url or a path.

links.description: Where to use the service, read about it and watch it.

dependsOn.description: The services this one needs, by name.

kind.description: A node: a machine the lab runs on, declared in platform/.

name.description: The node's name: what a component's runsOn names it by.

role.description: What the node is to the lab: what fails when it does.

platform.description: The node's operating system and architecture, as release assets name them.

address.description: Where the other nodes reach it: its name on the tailnet.

root.description: Where it installs components and their artifacts, written whole: {lab.root}, and LAB_ROOT on the node.

data.description: Where its services keep their state, written whole: {lab.data}, and LAB_DATA on the node.

docker.description: Where its Docker socket is, when it runs Docker: {node.docker}.

drives.description: The external drives it holds, where it mounts them: {node.drives}, comma-separated.

kind.description: What the component is used for: the icon it would have on a diagram.

workflow.description: The workflow that operates the component, whatever it is used for; it decides what else the document declares.

name.description: The component's name within its service.

displayName.description: The name people read, when the name is not it.

description.description: What the component is, in a sentence.

partOf.description: The component of this service this one lives inside: an app's SQLite database is part of the app.

dependsOn.description: The components of this service this one needs, by name.

requiresVolumes.description: The external drives it needs mounted, by mount point: a job refuses to run against one that is not, rather than write to the empty directory left in its place.

check.description: The check's slug, as its URL names it.

key.description: Where the account's ping key is: op://<vault>/<item>/<field>.

heartbeat.description: The healthchecks.io check it pings when its work is done: the dead man's switch that pages when it stops.

service.description: The compose service the component runs as, as the compose file names it: the container keeps Docker's unique name, the component the catalog's.

logs.description: How the component's logs reach the lab, when not as its output: otlp, when it sends its own.

port.description: The port the service serves its metrics on, in its own container.

path.description: The path it serves them on: /metrics unless it says otherwise.

published.description: The node's port to publish it on, when another service already holds the container's own number there.
